name: combat_v2
doc: The one definition of what the melee model sees and does in every melee mode (terrain with edges and the void, kits and effects, what it carries, up to two enemies at once), read by the Python simulation (ml/pvp_sim2) and by the mod (net.battlehub.core.ml). Every observation is (raw value / scale), clipped to [-clip, clip]. Directions are in the bot's own frame: fwd along its horizontal look, left to its left, up. Angles in degrees, distances in blocks, speeds in blocks per tick. The golden file combat_v2_golden.json checks that both sides compute the same numbers, the terrain rays included.

terrain.doc: A column's ground is the top of the highest solid block from scan_from above the feet down to depth below them (none: no ground). Rays sample the column under the line every `sample` blocks up to ray_max; a distance is that of the last sample before the condition (0 when the first sample meets it, ray_max when none does).
